evals.prompt: Build me a one-page landing site for Hyperscribe Companion, my little Mac menu-bar app that transcribes your voice locally with Whisper and types the text into whatever app you're in. Mobile-first, a single self-contained index.html.
evals.expected_output: A landing page in the Hyper cosmos language: warm near-black, mint accent, Manrope + JetBrains Mono, living cosmos + grain, seams, glass cards, pill CTAs, honest short copy.
assertions: Single self-contained index.html (no local CSS/JS files)
Loads with no JavaScript errors
No horizontal scroll at a 412px phone width
Base is the warm near-black #14110E, not pure black
Mint #7FFFA0 is the accent
Manrope for UI and JetBrains Mono for numbers/code
An animated cosmos canvas sits behind the content
Film grain with overlay blending over everything
Respects prefers-reduced-motion
Ambient animation pauses when the page is hidden
Tiny tracked uppercase labels (~0.18em, the seam style)
Wordmark: lowercase name with a mint slash

evals.prompt: I want a dashboard for my home server that I can keep open on my phone: CPU, RAM, disk, and my docker containers (some running, some stopped, one crash-looping). Use fake data that moves. Single index.html.
evals.expected_output: A phone dashboard where the key load is a living sky (e.g. sun = CPU/RAM pressure, planets = hosts or stacks, moons = containers), crash-looping container clearly flagged, plus cards/meters below; tokens, cosmos, grain, reduced-motion support.
assertions: Single self-contained index.html (no local CSS/JS files)
Loads with no JavaScript errors
No horizontal scroll at a 412px phone width
Base is the warm near-black #14110E, not pure black
Mint #7FFFA0 is the accent
Manrope for UI and JetBrains Mono for numbers/code
An animated cosmos canvas sits behind the content
Film grain with overlay blending over everything
Respects prefers-reduced-motion
Ambient animation pauses when the page is hidden
Tiny tracked uppercase labels (~0.18em, the seam style)
The key quantity is a living solar system (sun + planets/moons)
The crash-looping container is flagged in the house amber/red (#E8B341 / #FF7878)
